coaching.headline: Elite carry and support play couldn't make up for a four-of-five magic-resist gap and two fights started with the jungle and carry both pinned in losing lanes.
coaching.team: Towers finished 2-11, and the macro explains why: four of five players carried no magic resist into a comp that was four-fifths magical, and twice the squad started a fight while the jungle and the carry were both still pinned in losing lanes - the two fights tagged as bad trades. The team actually won four fights to the enemy's five, but only cashed two of those wins into a prize within 90 seconds - the win at Fangtooth (9.8m) still saw Mini Prime go to them in the same window, and the win at 35.8m still saw Primal Fangtooth go to them; the one clean break came at 29.7m, where the team lost the fight 0-2 but still secured Primal Fangtooth itself. The carry and the support both played the best games on the roster; the rest of the map didn't back them up.

focus.title: Don't start the coin-flip fight
focus.action: Before taking a 5v5, check whether the jungle or carry is already pinned in a losing lane - if either is, reset for farm or vision instead of fighting even on numbers.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong's jungle lane read unfavored against Aurora all game, and Gideon caught him alone three separate times - a bigger problem than the 2-5-2 scoreline shows. The damage output was well above the usual jungle rate, and after three straight games flagged for thin vision, the ward count actually came up this time - keep that fix. The next one is simple: stop getting caught alone by Gideon - it happened three times and fed an Outer Tower and an Inhibitor.
perPlayer.32d02b5f-f613-409c-a510-904500b998bb: Kwang ate first blood and five deaths total, but the damage stayed well above the usual offlane rate the whole game. Keep fighting through it - the lane was favored on paper and the macro notes back him being ahead more than once. Objective damage was almost nothing, though; some of that damage needs to land on structures, not just heroes.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow had the best game on the roster: fifteen kills on three deaths, built nowhere near the recommended core, and none of that mattered. Keep doing exactly this. The only tidy-up is spacing - three of those deaths came from getting caught alone or fighting in an exchange already lost, and reining that in turns a great individual game into a series win.
perPlayer.05dd8fc3-3c6b-458e-a2cf-f41284beceac: Scarlett's damage per minute was less than half the usual midlane rate, and the early solo death fed directly into the enemy's first Mini Prime. Review that one decision before touching the build - four off-meta items didn't help, but it's the positioning that cost the map early. The later deaths mostly came inside fights the team was already losing, which isn't on her alone.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel was the wall the team needed: one death, fourteen assists, by a wide margin the best KDA in the lobby. Keep playing this defensively. The itemization skipped the full recommended core entirely, and the squad as a whole brought magic resist on only one of five players against a comp that was four-fifths magical - that's the fix, not the playstyle.

9.8.call: Fangtooth fell our way at 9:48, but the enemy answered with Mini Prime in the same window - a trade, not a clean win.

20.4.call: Five versus four at 20:24 and the fight still went 1-2 before their Outer Tower fell our way anyway.

35.8.call: Opened three-versus-five at 35:48 and still won the bodies 3-1, but Primal Fangtooth still went to them.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: No winning-core comparison exists for Wukong. The missing magic-resist flag against a four-fifths-magical comp didn't help, but it wasn't the headline problem this game - the three solo deaths were.

32d02b5f-f613-409c-a510-904500b998bb.build: World Breaker, Prophecy, Tainted Guard and Oblivion Crown missed all three of the recommended core (Magnify, Tainted Scepter, Oathkeeper). The damage held up anyway, so this game doesn't prove the build cost the lane.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Tainted Rounds, Mistmeadow Buckler, Imperator and Terminus skipped the full recommended core (Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, Spectra) entirely. Fifteen kills on three deaths says the alternate path worked fine here.

05dd8fc3-3c6b-458e-a2cf-f41284beceac.build: Sky Splitter, Imperator, Demolisher and Vanquisher missed the whole recommended core (Mutilator, Infernum, The Perforator), and only four items finished by game's end. The low damage lines up with a build that never got there, but the early solo death was a positioning call, not an itemization one.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard, Fist Of Razuul and Raiment of Renewal left the full recommended core (Xenia, Dynamo, Gaia Greaves) unbuilt. One death and fourteen assists says it didn't cost the support game.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Steel's Eternal contribution isn't modeled in this review, so no effectiveness claim follows about Idrisil here.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
ourKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
ourKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
enemyKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain
